title: Universal Approximation of Nonlinear Operators and Their Derivatives
summary: We show that Universal Approximation (UA) of nonlinear operators and their derivatives via Operator Learning (OL) architectures fails in ${C^k_F}$ (Fréchet) compact-open topologies and in Fréchet--Sobolev norms (i.e. under operator norms). We solve this obstruction by restoring UA in natural weaker topologies: $C^k_B$ (Bastiani) compact-open topologies and (novel) weighted Bastiani--Sobolev spaces for general finite input measures.
